newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, fuel and gasoline up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, fuel and gasoline up.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Thursday.
Gas oil was hit by easier premiums and weaker futures. Only Russian cargo premiums held steady in thin trade.

Fuel oil firmed gently as crude held up but the markets were more notional than real. High sulphur barges gained $2 to $92 fob ARA before slipping back to $90-$91. Low sulphur cargo prices were held stable by weakness in the straight-run market.
Gasoline was encouraged by higher on gains in crude futures and amid good business. April swaps last traded at $216.50 fob ARA. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
